entities.summary: Ahmad Mostafavi Khomeini was an Iranian cleric and politician who was Custodian of the Mausoleum of Khomeini from 1989 until his death in 1995. A member of the Khomeini family and the second son of the first Iranian supreme leader Ruhollah Khomeini, Khomeini was the "right-hand" of his father before, during and after the Iranian Revolution, and also held key positions during his father's rule.
